## pOkno

```fand
{proc(okno,('\1',7,3,72,13,'\178'));}
(x:string;a:real;b:real;c:real;d:real;e:string)
var a1, b1, cas, f, g, h, i, j, k, l:real; interval:real=00:00:02;
begin a1:=(a+c)/2; b1:=(b+d)/2; j:=a1-a; k:=b1-b;             { PROC okno NIE JE DORIESENA     }
  if j>k then begin f:=1; g:=0; l:=0;                         {                                }
  end else begin                                              {                                }
    if j=k then begin f:=1; g:=1; l:=1;                       { farba, x1, y1, x2, y2, znak    }
    end else begin f:=0; g:=1; l:=2;                          {                                }
    end;                                                      {   (x1,y1)───────────────────┐  }
  end;                                                        {    │                        │  }
  repeat h:=(b1-g);                                           {    └───────────────────(x2,y2) }
    repeat gotoxy(a1-f,h); write(x+repeatstr(e,2*f)); h:=h+1; until h-1>b1+g;
    if l=0 then begin f:=2*f; g:=g+1;
    end else begin
      if l=1 then begin f:=f+1; g:=g+1;
      end else begin f:=f+1; g:=2*g; end;
    end;
  until (f>j)|(g>k); l:=d-b;
  repeat gotoxy(a,b); write(x+repeatstr(e,c-a)); delay(2000); l:=l+1; b:=b+1;
  until l>d;
END;
```

```fand
    ------------
```

## pSklad

```fand
var x, br, re, ir, ref, irf : real; bro, fil : boolean = true;
    s : record of Sklad; z : record of KZpol; k : record of KZ;
begin fil := false;

  merge(['#I1_ sklad #O1_ sklad v := zaruka_do']);


  if sklad.nrecs=0 then with window(20,9,61,17,='' !,^W) do begin
    GoToXY(5,3); Write('              Sklad');
    GoToXY(7,5); Write('         je prázdny !');
    sound(70); delay(3500); sound(70); delay(2000); nosound; delay(3500); exit;
  end;
  with window (1,2,80,24,@) do repeat
   if fil then begin
    if ^bro | Sklad.nrecs=0 then
      edit(Sklad, eSklad, mode='??', recno = ref, irec = 3, ctrl='',
           cond=(pos(PARAM.Nazov,popis1)>0),
           head=' DATOVÝ EDITOR                          Karta č. ___                   __.__.__',
           last=' F1     F3celý sklad                                            F9Browse info',
           ww=(2,3,79,24,=''!,^B,^S,^E,^W),
           exit=(F4,CtrlF7,CtrlF4:pPrazdna, F3,F9:quit, F7:pHlaSklad))
    else
      edit(Sklad, eSkladBr, mode='^n?y', recno = ref, irec = irf, ctrl='',
           cond=(pos(PARAM.Nazov,popis1)>0),
           head=' DATOVÝ EDITOR             Tovar na sklade číslo ____                  __.__.__',
           last=' F1     F3celý sklad                                            F9Úplné info ',
           ww=(1,3,79,24,=''!,^B,^S,^E,^W),
           exit=(F2,F4,CtrlF7,CtrlF4:pPrazdna, F3,F9:quit, F7:pHlaSklad));
     ref := edrecno; if bro then irf := edirec;
     br := edbreak; if br = 29 then bro:=^bro;

    if ^bro | Sklad.nrecs=0 then
      edit(Sklad, eSklad, mode='??', recno = re, irec = 3, ctrl='',
           head=' DATOVÝ EDITOR                          Karta č. ___                   __.__.__',
           last=' F1     F3Filter             F8Hľadaj výr. číslo F9Hľadaj názov F10Browse info',
```

## pUhrady_All

```fand
var x, re : real; brow : boolean = true;
    uh : record of uhrady; p : record of KP; z : record of KZ;
begin re := uhrady.nrecs;
{ forall x in uh ! % do begin
    if uh.pc>0 then begin x := recno(KP/@, uh.a, uh.b);
      if x >0 then begin readrec(p, x); p.uhrady += 1; writerec(p, x); end;
    end else begin x := recno(KZ/@, uh.a, uh.b);
      if x >0 then begin readrec(z, x); z.uhrady += 1; writerec(z, x); end;
    end;
  end;
}
{ edit(kp, (a,b), cond=(uhrady=0)); edit(kp, (a,b,uhrady), cond=(uhrady>1));
```

```fand
      Catalog[c].Navesti := ' ';
    end; ResetCatalog;
    x:=1; while sp.datum>pd[x].a & x<PD.nrecs do x += 1;
    edit(PD, ePDbrowse, mode='#L!!^y^n', recno=x, irec=10, cond=(vydaj='2'),
         head=' DATOVÝ EDITOR                    Riadok číslo ____                    __.__.__',

  if br>22 & br<27 then begin x:=edrecno;

    if c<=spotreba.nrecs then readrec(sp,c) else exit;
    if br=23 then sp.servis += pd[x].a2+pd[x].a4;

    if br=25 then sp.invest += pd[x].a2+pd[x].a4;
    if br=26 then sp.ine    += pd[x].a2+pd[x].a4;
    sp.popis := cond(sp.popis<>~'' : trailchar(' ',sp.popis)+' * ')+
                     pd[x].d; writerec(sp,c);
  end;
  if ParamCat.Rok <> val(strdate(sp.datum,'YYYY')) then
    forall c in Catalog (upcase(nazsouboru)=~'PD') % do begin

end;
```

## pKonSpotreba

```fand
(s : record of Spotreba) var pomer : real;
begin { spotr := ( litre / km ) * 100 }
  pomer := cond (SpotPrie[1].uspora > 0 &
                 SpotPrie[1].spotr_posled > SpotPrie[1].spotr_lpg :
                 1 / (SpotPrie[1].spotr_lpg / SpotPrie[1].spotr_posled),
                 SpotPrie[1].uspora = 0 &
                 SpotPrie[1].spotr_posled > SpotPrie[1].spotr :
                 1 / (SpotPrie[1].spotr / SpotPrie[1].spotr_posled),
                 else : 1);
  SpotPrie[1].koniec_km :=
    SpotPrie[1].zacia_km + (pomer * ( s.litre /
           cond (SpotPrie[1].uspora = 0 : SpotPrie[1].spotr, else : SpotPrie[1].spotr_lpg) * 100));
end;
```

## pSp_Auto_Opr

```fand
var x, y : real=2; E,A : record of Spotreba;
begin merge(['#I1_Spotreba/iDat #O1_Spotreba']); if Spotreba.nrecs < 1 then exit;
  forall x in Spotreba/iKodA (key in [(par.kod)]) ! % do begin
    readrec(E, x-1); readrec(A, x); y := A.km;
    if E.koniec_km <> A.zacia_km & e.kod=a.kod then A.zacia_km := E.koniec_km;
    A.koniec_km := y + cond(e.kod=a.kod : E.koniec_km, else : A.zacia_km);
    if x>1 then writerec(A, x);
  end;
end;
```

## pEvi_AutoSum

```fand
var i : real; ev_pom : file [ Poc_km : F,6.1; spolu : F,6.2];
begin gotoxy(33,23);
  merge(['#I1_ Evi_Auto (kod=Par.kod) #O_ev_pom poc_km := sum(I1.poc_km); spolu := sum(I1.spolu)']);
  if ev_pom.nrecs>0 then
    write(' Spolu :      '+str(ev_pom[1].Poc_km,'____0')+'           '+str(ev_pom[1].spolu,'______,__')+' ');
  gotoxy(1,24); i := recno(Auto/@, Par.kod);
  if i>0 then
    write('           Auv : '+trailchar(' ',Auto[i].Typ)+'  ŠPZ : '+Auto[i].SPZ+' ');
end;
```

## pKm_Kon_Vzd

```fand
(E:record of evi_auto) var x : real; A : record of evi_auto;
begin readrec(A, edrecno);
  if E.kon_km < E.zac_km then begin
    if promptYN(' Zmeniť konečný stav tachometra z '+
                  str(A.kon_km,'______')+' na '+
                  str(A.zac_km+E.kon_km,'______')+' ? (A/N) _ ') then begin
      E.kon_km := E.zac_km + E.kon_km; setkeybuf('\0\101');
    end else E.kon_km := A.kon_km;
  end;
end;
```

## pKm_Auto_Opr

```fand
var E,A : record of evi_auto; k : record of kalendar;
                         JU              16.08.2026     strana: 71
Typ Nazev
Text
    s : record of SC; t, i, x, y, z, r : real = 0; bbb : boolean;
    Spot_pom : file [DATUM:D,'DD.MM.YYYY'; LITRE:F,2.2;
                     MIESTO:A,40; DO_PLNA:B ];
begin merge(['#I1_ evi_auto/@ #O1_evi_auto']); close; proc(pSc_Kontrola); close;
  bbb := true; {promptYN('Mám skontrolovať aj ceny PHM ? (A/N) ');} e.datum := 0;
  param.dat2:=valdate('01.01.'+strdate(paramcat.rok,'YYYY'),'DD.MM.YYYY');
  if bbb then forall x in a/@ (kod=par.kod) ! % do begin z+=1; close;
    y := A.poc_km; param.dat2:=a.datum; {save;} close;
    if z>1 then if E.kon_km <> A.zac_km then A.zac_km := E.kon_km;
{ trasy } t := recno ( Trasy/iTrZDo, a.odkial, a.kam );
    if t>0 then begin if a.tra = 0 then a.tra := trasy[t].tra;
      a.mesto_2_km_pocet := trasy[t].mesto_2_km_pocet;
      a.mesto_5_km_pocet := trasy[t].mesto_5_km_pocet;
      a.mesto_10_km_pocet := trasy[t].mesto_10_km_pocet;
    end;
    if a.datum=e.datum then begin A.DPH:=e.DPH; A.cena_PHM:=e.cena_PHM;
    end else begin param.cislo := -1; param.aktcas := addwdays(a.datum, 1);
      while param.cislo<0 do begin param.aktcas := addwdays(param.aktcas, -1);
        param.cislo := recno(Spotreba/iDat_, a.kod, param.aktcas);
        if param.cislo>0 &
           ((^a.lpg & Spotreba[param.cislo].Sk_na_1l = 0) |
            ( a.lpg & Spotreba[param.cislo].Sk_be_1l = 0)) then
          param.cislo := -1;
      end; A.DPH:=Spotreba[param.cislo].DPH;
      if ^a.lpg then A.cena_PHM:=Spotreba[param.cislo].Sk_na_1l
                else A.cena_PHM:=Spotreba[param.cislo].Sk_be_1l;

{ *** v odkial = sukr. cesta > dovolenka a pod. }
      if pos('***', a.odkial) > 0 then a.cena_phm := 0;

    end; A.kon_km := A.zac_km + y;
{
    merge(['#I1_ spotreba #O1_spot_pom']);
}
    writerec(A, x); E := A;
  end; y:=0; x:=0;
  forall y in k ! % do begin k.sc := 0; writerec(k,y); end;
  forall y in S ! % do begin S.Celpg := 0; S.CeBenz := 0;
    x := recno(Kalendar/@, s.zaciatok);
    if x>0 then begin readrec(k, x); k.sc += 1; writerec(k, x) end; x:=0;
    forall x in E (bb = S.bb) ! do begin S.DPH := E.DPH;
      if E.LPG then begin S.Celpg := E.cena_phm;
      end else begin S.CeBenz := E.cena_phm; end;
    end; writerec(S, y);
  end; close;
end;


    pKm_Opr_Zv  

var s : record of SC; x, y, z, r : real = 0; A : record of evi_auto;
begin merge(['#I1_ evi_auto/@ #O1_evi_auto']); close;
  forall x in evi_auto/@ (kod=par.kod & ((odkial=~'Zvolen' & kam=~'Banská Bystrica') | (kam=~'Zvolen' & odkial=~'Banská Bystrica'))) ! % do begin readrec(A, x);
  A.kon_km := A.zac_km + 29; writerec(A, x);
  forall y in S (cislo = ~A.cislo) ! do begin
    S.pockm  := 0; writerec(S, y);
  end;
  forall y in S (cislo = ~A.cislo) ! do begin
    S.pockm += 2 * A.poc_km; writerec(S, y);
  end;
  forall y in PD (copy(b,1,2)='40' & Scislo=A.cislo) ! do PD[y].a2 := S.spolu;
  end;
end;
```

## pDovod_SC

```fand
(K:record of evi_auto)
var dovod_sc : file [ n : A,40 ]; e : string; partneri : boolean;
begin merge(['#I1_ evi_auto ! (ucel<>~'''') ~ucel #O_dovod_sc n:=I1.ucel']);
  if Par.cena_PHM=0 & K.cena_PHM<>0 then Par.cena_PHM:=K.cena_PHM;
  if dovod_sc.nrecs=0 then begin
    merge(['#I1_ udajo ! (naz_mie<>~'''') ~naz_mie #O_dovod_sc n:=I1.naz_mie']);
    partneri := true;
  end; if dovod_sc.nrecs=0 then exit;
  e := '                  Účel cesty\13'+
       '──────────────────────────────────────────\13'+
       '#_dovod_sc n; \13'+
       ' ________________________________________';
  repeat
    edit(dovod_SC, [e], ctrl='',
         head=' DATOVÝ EDITOR              Zadávanie novej položky                    __.__.__',
         last=cond(partneri:' F1Načítaj účely z dôvodov SC            Vyberte účel cesty F3',
                       else:' F1Načítaj účely z obchod. partnerov     Vyberte účel cesty F3'),
           ww=(36,4,79,24,='',^S,^W,^E,^B), exit=(F1,F3:quit));
    if edbreak=21 then begin
      if partneri then
        merge(['#I1_ evi_auto ! (ucel<>~'''') ~ucel #O_dovod_sc n:=I1.ucel'])
      else
        merge(['#I1_ udajo ! (naz_mie<>~'''') ~naz_mie #O_dovod_sc n:=I1.naz_mie']);
    end;
  until edbreak=23 | edbreak=0;
  if edbreak=23 then begin K.ucel := dovod_sc[edrecno].n; Par.zac_km:=K.kon_km;
    PARAM.a1234 := 1; par.zaciatoh := PARAM.koniec;
    par.konieh := par.zaciatoh+k.koniec-k.zaciatok; setkeybuf('\13');
  end; dovod_sc.nrecs:=0;
end;
```

```fand
(p:record of Vydaje) var q:record of Vydaje; c,x,y : real;
begin gotoxy(5,5); readrec(q, edrecno);
  write(p.kod,' ',q.kod); delay(55555555);
  if p.kod<>q.kod then begin
    PARAM.doklad := q.kod; save; close; write(' ',PARAM.doklad); delay(55555555);
    if recno(Vydaje/@, p.kod)>0 | recno(Vydaje/@, p.kod)>0 then exit;
    for x := 1991 to val(strdate(today,'YYYY')) do begin writeln(x:4);
      forall c in Catalog % do begin
        Catalog[c].Cesta := 'd:\fand\ju\delf'+str(x,4,0)+'\'+trailchar(' ',Catalog[c].NazSouboru)+'.000';
        Catalog[c].Navesti := ' ';
      end; sort(Catalog, (~NazUlohy,~NazSouboru)); ResetCatalog; close;
      forall y in PD (vydaj=PARAM.doklad & (a2>0 | a4>0)) ! % do begin
        PD[y].vydaj:=p.kod; close;
      end;
      forall y in KZ (vydaj=PARAM.doklad) ! % do begin
        KZ[y].vydaj:=p.kod; close;
      end;
    end;
  end;
end;
```

```fand
    if KP[c].prijem='x' then KP[c].prijem:='X';
    if KP[c].prijem='z' then KP[c].prijem:='Z';
  end;
  forall c in EZ ! % do begin close;
    if EZ[c].prijem='1' then EZ[c].prijem:='S';
    if EZ[c].prijem='p' then EZ[c].prijem:='T';
    if EZ[c].prijem='r' then EZ[c].prijem:='R';
     ,_ if EZ[c].prijem='x' then EZ[c].prijem:='X';
    if EZ[c].prijem='z' then EZ[c].prijem:='Z';
  end;
  forall c in KZ ! % do begin close;
    if KZ[c].vydaj='T' then KZ[c].vydaj:='t';
  end;
end;
```

```fand
var KZPom : file [ n : F,2,0; zn : F,7.2; kodOP:F,3,0; od :A,40;
                  #C kod := str(kodOP,3,0):A,3; ns := str(n,2,0):A,2 ];

begin merge(['#I1_ KZ ! (rok_s = paramCat.rok_s & a<=today) od #O_KZpom zn:=sum(I1.zn); n:=I1.count']);
  ret := '                Dodávateľ               Kód      Suma    x\13'+
         '───────────────────────────────────────────────── Sk ──────\13'+
         '#_ KZPom od, kod, zn, ns;\13'+
         ' ______________________________________ ___ ___________ __';
  sort(KzPom, (>n,~od)); { setkeybuf('\0\67'); }
  if KZpom.nrecs>0 then with window (1,2,80,24,@) do repeat
    edit(KzPom, [ret], mode='??^n', ctrl='',
         head=' DATOVÝ EDITOR                   Položka č. ___                        __.__.__',
         last='               F1Všetci obch. partneri  F3Výber položky    F9Hľadaj',
           ww=((19,5,79,24,=''!,^B,^S,^E,^B)),
         exit=(F1,F9,F3:quit)); readrec(pom, edrecno);
    if edbreak=29 then with window(1,25,80,25,,^E) do begin
      PARAM.a := upcase(prompt('                 Zadajte  hľadaný reťazec : ':A,25:=' '));
      if param.a<>~'' then setkeybuf('\0\64Npos('''+trailchar(' ',PARAM.a)+''',od,''~'')<>0\13\0\132\0\80');
    end;
  until edbreak=0 | edbreak=21 | edbreak=23;
  if edbreak = 21 | KZpom.nrecs=0 then begin proc(pTlf_odber); exit end; PARAM.NazMie := '';
  if edbreak=23 then begin x := recno(UdajO/iKodOP, KZpom[edrecno].kodOP);
    if x<0 then exit; param.zak := UdajO[x].kodOP;
    PARAM.NazMie := UdajO[x].naz_mie;  PARAM.Miesto := UdajO[x].Cu;
    PARAM.var_sym := UdajO[x].var_sym; PARAM.kon_sym := UdajO[x].kon_sym;
    PARAM.spc_sym := UdajO[x].spc_sym; setkeybuf('\13\13')
  end;
end;
```

## pVypisCislo

```fand
(U : record of ucet) var m,r,n : real;
begin m := val(strdate(u.d,'MM')); r := val(strdate(u.d,'YYYY'));
  if u.d < valdate('12.09.2003','DD.MM.YYYY') then begin
    if val(strdate(u.d,'DD'))>11 then begin
      u.a := valdate('11.'+ cond(m=12 : '01', else : str(m+1,'00'))+
             '.' + cond(m=12 : str(r+1,'0000'), else : str(r,'0000')),'DD.MM.YYYY');
      u.b := cond(m=12 : '1', else : str(m+1,'00'));
    end else begin
      u.a := valdate('11.'+ str(m,'00')+'.'+ str(r,'0000'),'DD.MM.YYYY');
      u.b := str(m,'00');
    end;
  end else begin
    param.dat2 := addmonth(u.d,1); save;
    param.dat2 := valdate('01.'+strdate(param.dat2,'MM.YYYY'),'DD.MM.YYYY'); save;
    param.dat2 := param.dat2 - 1;
    u.a := valdate(strdate(param.dat2,'DD.')+ str(m,'00')+'.'+
                   str(r,'0000'),'DD.MM.YYYY');
    if u.d < valdate('01.01.2004','DD.MM.YYYY') then u.b := str(m+1,'00')
                                                else u.b := str(m,'00');
  end;
end;
```

```fand
           Vydaje[f].b15 : {dary, pohost} PD[pocet].a15 := PD[pocet].a2 + PD[pocet].a4;
           Vydaje[f].b16 : {dan z prijmu} PD[pocet].a16 := PD[pocet].a2 + PD[pocet].a4;
           Vydaje[f].b17 : {osobny ucet } PD[pocet].a17 := PD[pocet].a2 + PD[pocet].a4;
      end;
      PD[pocet].vydaj := vydaje[f].kodvyd;
      PD[pocet].r :=Vydaje[f].r; PD[pocet].p :=Vydaje[f].p; PD[pocet].ok:='h';
{      PD[pocet].a12:=PD[pocet].a2+PD[pocet].a4;}
    end;
  end;
  if PD[pocet].a2 + PD[pocet].a4 = 0 { &
     promptYN( 'Zrušiť novozadávanú prázdnu položku peňažného denníka ?') }
     then deleterec(PD, pocet);
end;
```

```fand
var i : real = 1; datum : string;
begin PARAM.cislo:=edrecno;
  PARAM.nazmie := str(edrecno,'__0')+' '+PD[edrecno].b+' '+
                      trailchar(' ',copy(PD[edrecno].d,1,30));
  with window ((1,25,80,25)) do
    write('                           Moment, rátam sumár .......                         ');
  IF PV.NRECS=0 THEN PROC(pPV);
  PARAM.Dat2:=PD[edrecno].a; datum:=strdate(PD[edrecno].a,'YYYY');
  PARAM.Dat1:=valdate('1.1.'+datum,'DD.MM.YYYY');
  SumaPD.nrecs:=0; merge(mPDsuma); merge(mPDsuma_);
  i:=1;
  forall i in SC (koniec<=PD[PARAM.cislo].A) % do SumaPD[1].a123 += SC[i].spolu;
  i:=1;
  forall i in IKzp % do begin
    if IKzp[i].HB<=PD[edrecno].A & IKzp[i].vo>0 then begin
      SumaPD[1].zZP    := SumaPD[1].zZP    + IKzp[i].hz;
      SumaPD[1].odpisy := SumaPD[1].odpisy + IKzp[i].vo;
      SumaPD[1].zp     := SumaPD[1].zp     + IKzp[i].z;
    end;
  end;
  i:=1;
  forall i in StraDoch (rok = (val(strdate(PD[edrecno].a,'YYYY')) - 1)) do begin
    SumaPD[1].strata := StraDoch[i].strata;
{   SumaPD[1].dochodok := StraDoch[i].dochodok;}
  end;
  if datum = '2024' then SumaPD[1].dochodok := 0;
  forall i in StraDoch (rok = (val(strdate(PD[edrecno].a,'YYYY')))) do begin
    SumaPD[1].nezdan_suma := StraDoch[i].nezdan_suma;
    SumaPD[1].hra_min_prijmu := StraDoch[i].hra_min_prijmu;
  end;
  SumaPD[1].rok_1  := str ( val(strdate(PD[edrecno].a,'YYYY')) - 1, 4, 0);
  i:=1;
  forall i in Leasing % do begin
    if Leasing[i].a<=PD[edrecno].A & Leasing[i].vo>0 then
      SumaPD[1].leas := SumaPD[1].leas + Leasing[i].vo;
  end; SumaPD[1].a20 := PV[1].m + SumaPD[1].zaklad;
  SumaPD[1].P1 := PV[1].PH; SumaPD[1].P2 := PV[1].PU;
  SumaPD[1].P3 := PV[1].m;  SumaPD[1].a  := PD[edrecno].a;
  SumaPD[1].PO := PARAM.cislo; setkeybuf('\0\93');
  with window ((1,25,80,25)) do write('                                                                                 ');
  edit(SumaPD, eSumaPD,

end;
```

## pHladac

```fand
{}
var s: string;
begin
  repeat s:=readkey;
    case
      Ord(s)=27 | Ord(s)=13 | Ord(s)=0 :
       begin                      {vyčistím buffry}
        param.NameSearch:=''; param.NSearch:=0;
        clrscr(1,25,40,25);       {plynule prejde zo zadávania}
        if ord(s)=0 then begin    {do listovania podľa kurzor. kláves}
          ClearKeyBuf; SetKeyBuf(s);
        end; PARAM.ok:=true; exit;
       end;
      Ord(s)=8 :                  {delete char}
       if length(Trailchar(' ',param.NameSearch))>0 then begin
         param.NSearch:=param.NSearch-1;
         param.NameSearch:= copy(param.NameSearch,1,param.NSearch);
       end;
      Ord(s)>31 :
       begin
         param.NameSearch:=copy(param.NameSearch,1,param.NSearch)+s;
         param.NSearch+=1;
       end;
    else PARAM.ok:=true; exit; end; write(s);
  until ^KeyPressed;
end;
```

## pBytNovyPred

```fand
var b,r,i,x,y,c:real; a:string; n_o : record of Byt;
    byt_like : file [ mr : D,'MM.YYYY' ];
begin merge(['#I1_byt #O1_byt_like']); sort(byt_like, (mr));
  with window (1,1,80,24,@) do begin gotoxy(5, 24);
    repeat
      a := prompt(' Od akého obdobia platí zálohový predpis ? (0=prerušenie)  ':A,'##.####':= strdate(byt_like[byt_like.nrecs].mr,'MM.YYYY'));
      b:=val(a); if b=0 then break;
    until recno(byt/@, b)<=0 | b=0; if b=0 then exit; param.dat0 := b;
    c:=recno(byt/@, byt_like[byt_like.nrecs].mr);
    if c>0 then readrec(n_o, c); setkeybuf('\0\95\0\118\0\71');
    if byt_like.nrecs>0 then n_o.mo:=byt_like[byt_like.nrecs].mr;
    n_o.mr:=param.dat0; writerec(n_o, 0); close;
  end;
end;
```

## pOpravElSasa

```fand
var b,r,i,x,y,c:real=0; a:string; ink : record of ElSasa;
    elsa_pom : file.x [like elsasa;];
begin merge(['#I1_ elsasa/@ #O1_elsa_pom']); {edit(elsa_pom,());}
  merge(['#I1_elsa_pom #O1_elsasa']); save; close;
  forall x in ink/@ ! % do begin
    ink.dph := 19;
    if ink.el_rok=2005 then ink.sk_n := 1.35;
    if ink.el_rok=2005 then ink.pausal := 510;
    if ink.el_rok=2006 then ink.sk_n := 1.35;
    if ink.el_rok=2006 then ink.pausal := 510;
    if ink.el_rok=2007 then ink.sk_n := 1.96;
    if ink.el_rok=2007 then ink.pausal := 178.5;
    if ink.el_rok=2008 then ink.sk_n := 2.15;
    if ink.el_rok=2008 then ink.pausal := 375;
    if ink.el_rok=2010 then ink.sk_n := 2.45;
    if ink.el_rok=2010 then ink.sk_v := 5.30;
    if ink.el_rok=2010 then ink.pausal := 332.6;
    if ink.el_rok>2010 then ink.dph := 20;
    if ink.el_rok=2011 then ink.sk_n := 2.815;
    if ink.el_rok=2011 then ink.sk_v := 5.808;
    if ink.el_rok=2011 then ink.pausal := 339.52;
    if ink.el_rok=2012 then ink.sk_n := 2.899;
    if ink.el_rok=2012 then ink.sk_v := 5.837;
    if ink.el_rok=2012 then ink.pausal := 339.52;
    if ink.el_rok=2013 then ink.sk_n := 2.968;
    if ink.el_rok=2013 then ink.sk_v := 5.823;
    if ink.el_rok=2013 then ink.pausal := 303.67;
    if ink.el_rok=2014 then begin
      if ink.mr < valdate('04.02.2014', 'DD.MM.YYYY') then begin
        ink.sk_n := 2.619;
        ink.sk_v := 4.943;
        ink.pausal := 314.52;
      end else begin
        ink.sk_n := 2.378;
        ink.sk_v := 5.45;
        ink.pausal := 294.93;
      end;
    end;
    if x > 21 then begin
      if ink.mp <> elsasa[x-1].mr then begin
        ink.mp := elsasa[x-1].mr;
      end;
    end; writerec(ink, x);
  end;
end;
```

```fand
(s : record of Spotreba) var pomer : real;

                 SpotPrie[1].uspora = 0 &

  SpotPrie[1].koniec_km :=

       cond (SpotPrie[1].uspora = 0 : SpotPrie[1].spotr, else : SpotPrie[1].spotr_lpg) * 100));

    Spot_n[1].opravy += sp.oprava; Spot_n[1].invest += sp.Invest;
    Spot_n[1].ine += sp.Ine;
  end;
  if a=1 then for x:=edrecno to Spotreba.nrecs do begin readrec(sp, x);
```

```fand
  pomer := cond (SpotPrie[1].uspora > 0 &
                 SpotPrie[1].spotr_posled > SpotPrie[1].spotr_lpg :

                 SpotPrie[1].uspora = 0 &

                                  else : 1);
```

```fand
(s : record of Spotreba) var pomer : real;
begin { spotr := ( litre / km ) * 100 }
  pomer := cond (SpotPrie[1].uspora > 0 &
                 SpotPrie[1].spotr_posled > SpotPrie[1].spotr_lpg :
                 1 / (SpotPrie[1].spotr_lpg / SpotPrie[1].spotr_posled),
                 SpotPrie[1].uspora = 0 &
                 SpotPrie[1].spotr_posled > SpotPrie[1].spotr :

                                  else : 1);
  SpotPrie[1].koniec_km :=
    SpotPrie[1].zacia_km + (pomer * ( s.litre /
       cond (SpotPrie[1].uspora = 0 : SpotPrie[1].spotr, else : SpotPrie[1].spotr_lpg) * 100));

  if Auto.nrecs>1 | Auto.nrecs=0 then proc(pAuto) else PAR.kod := Auto[1].kod;
  if PAR.kod = ~'' then begin
    message('Nie je zvolené oiadne auto !'); exit; end;
  par.zaciatok := 0; par.zaciatoh := 0; setkeybuf('\0\118\0\71\0\103');
  with window (1,2,80,24,@) do repeat if Evi_Auto.nrecs=0 then browse := false;
    if browse then
      edit(Evi_Auto/iKod, d_  eEvi_Auto, mode='??^n?y', recno=re, irec=ir,
           cond=(key in [(par.kod)]), Ctrl='',
```

```fand
(s : record of Spotreba) var pomer : real;
begin { spotr := ( litre / km ) * 100 }
  pomer := cond (SpotPrie[1].uspora > 0 &
                 SpotPrie[1].spotr_posled > SpotPrie[1].spotr_lpg :
                 1 / (SpotPrie[1].spotr_lpg / SpotPrie[1].spotr_posled),
                 SpotPrie[1].uspora = 0 &
                 SpotPrie[1].spotr_posled > SpotPrie[1].spotr :
                 1 / (SpotPrie[1].spotr / SpotPrie[1].spotr_posled),
                                  else : 1);
  SpotPrie[1].koniec_km :=
    SpotPrie[1].zacia_km + (pomer * ( s.litre /
       cond (SpotPrie[1].uspora = 0 : SpotPrie[1].spotr, else : SpotPrie[1].spotr_lpg) * 100));
end;
```

```fand
(s : record of Spotreba) var pomer : real;
begin { spotr := ( litre / km ) * 100 }
  pomer := cond (SpotPrie[1].uspora > 0 &
                 SpotPrie[1].spotr_posled > SpotPrie[1].spotr_lpg :
                 1 / (SpotPrie[1].spotr_lpg / SpotPrie[1].spotr_posled),
                 SpotPrie[1].uspora = 0 &
                 SpotPrie[1].spotr_posled > SpotPrie[1].spotr :
                 1 / (SpotPrie[1].spotr / SpotPrie[1].spotr_posled),
                                  else : 1);
  SpotPrie[1].koniec_km :=
    SpotPrie[1].zacia_km + (pomer * ( s.litre /
       cond (SpotPrie[1].uspora = 0 : SpotPrie[1].spotr, else : SpotPrie[1].spotr_lpg) * 100));
end;
```

```fand
(s : record of Spotreba) var pomer : real;
begin { spotr := ( litre / km ) * 100 }
  pomer := cond (SpotPrie[1].uspora > 0 &
                 SpotPrie[1].spotr_posled > SpotPrie[1].spotr_lpg :
                 1 / (SpotPrie[1].spotr_lpg / SpotPrie[1].spotr_posled),
                 SpotPrie[1].uspora = 0 &
                 SpotPrie[1].spotr_posled > SpotPrie[1].spotr :
                 1 / (SpotPrie[1].spotr / SpotPrie[1].spotr_posled),
                                  else : 1);
  SpotPrie[1].koniec_km :=
    SpotPrie[1].zacia_km + (pomer * ( s.litre /
       cond (SpotPrie[1].uspora = 0 : SpotPrie[1].spotr, else : SpotPrie[1].spotr_lpg) * 100));
end;

    Spot_n[1].opravy += sp.oprava; Spot_n[1].invest += sp.Invest;
    Spot_n[1].ine += sp.Ine;
  end;
  if a=1 then for x:=edrecno to Spotreba.nrecs do begin readrec(sp, x);
```
